_template: Mare Liberum 3.79.0 · every 402 answer of the sea keeps its own body (x402 v1: x402Version, error, accepts; the door's own fields) and gets the field next_step. Built in node/core.mjs (nextStepOf, paywallAfter); proven by tools/contacts-proof.mjs: an agent that knows only this body runs next_step.steps and its next request gets the answer. <…> = filled per call; {key} = what the step before kept; {x402 payment for accepts[0]} = what any x402 client signs from accepts[0].

next_step.say: No wallet? This command gets a key with 20 probe calls (one call, no account) and sends this call again with it.
next_step.run: KEY=$(curl -sf -X POST 'https://mareliberum.dev/session?as=key') && curl -s '<the same url>' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"

steps.body: <the same JSON body, only if one was sent>

or.say: With a wallet: sign accepts[0] of this answer (x402 exact, USDC on Base, EIP-3009) and send this call again with the header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2; X-PAYMENT for v1). An x402 client does both by itself.

B_free_door_past_its_limit._where: GET /deal (10 an hour), /check (20 an hour), /r/<page> and /read (100 a day): steps[1] goes to the paid twin /x402/deal, /x402/check or /x402/read?url=<page>

steps: …as in A, steps[1] on the paid twin…

next_step.say: Send this call to the paid door with your session key ({key}): it takes one probe call there.

D_spent_key_or_door_without_session._where: a key whose 20 probe calls are spent (or the sea's 2,000 of the day), and the doors no session opens: /x402/pack, POST /reader/credit, /fair/pay, the toll

next_step.say: With a wallet: sign accepts[0] of this answer (x402 exact, USDC on Base, EIP-3009) and send this call again with the header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2; X-PAYMENT for v1). An x402 client does both by itself.
next_step.note: the probe calls of this key are spent (or the probe calls of the sea for today): this call is paid now

next_step.say: Pay as the WWW-Authenticate header of this answer asks (MPP, method stripe: a Shared Payment Token) and send this call again with the header Authorization: Payment <credential>.
